notes.title: Major End-of-Month Update + New Game "Nice City" Page Live - Wishlist Now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

At the end of this month, during the National Day holiday, Campus Fantasy will get a major update! This update will mainly conclude the main storyline. Thanks for your continuous support!

Additionally, my new game "Nice City" store page is now live! Hope you can wishlist it.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4028160/_/

My new game is a 3D open-world RPG with multiplayer support, featuring an engaging story and characters from Campus Fantasy and Return to Campus (like Xiao Hei) who travel through time. Scheduled for release in Q1 2026.

Thanks again for all your support!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45390979/1f01492813c6eed4a6d81efa7315bd6629dd3db6.png

Nie Yuxing

notes.title: Content updates and bug fixes
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue that rich children from being late for class would be punished for standing



2. Newly added Superman mode, you can press the R key to pee while riding the somersault cloud



3. Fixed the poor child's version of being attacked by security guards when time is stationary

4. Optimized the prompt for buying a car, prompting the mobile phone key and summoning the car



5. Fixed a bug where a rich kid would drop out of the map if he teleported directly from school to the 4S store to buy props



6. Fixed a bug where a rich kid doesn't need to buy a property to get into the property directly



7. Optimized the interpolation of the 50 series, and now the 50 series interpolation supports 4 times the interpolation of the frame



8. Added a new main story of Xiao Hei buying an airplane, and there will be a prompt to buy things in the future



9. Fixed a bug where taking the subway back to school from the theater would turn into a poor kid



10. Added that throwing money will attract students around you, and follow the protagonist to move



11. The full crowdfunding list has been added to the thank you list

notes.title: Subsequent update plan
notes.notes: Dear players, many people have reported that the Rich Child version is too short and not enough to play, so the playability is a little bit worse, so I decided to add another hour of main storyline and add a new love line. Later, I will improve the ending of the Poor Child storyline, increasing the storyline from four chapters to six. Please wait for a while, the update content will come soon.

notes.title: Title: Urgently update a version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I have urgently updated a version. Except for the love system, everything else is available. The complete process is not affected. I will update the love version again after fixing the crash bug. Thank you for your support.

Nie Yuxing
